product_one_liner.value: Lob automates personalized, data-triggered direct mail—from campaign creation and routing to printing and delivery—for organizations running direct-mail programs at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes automated, personalized direct mail and its print and delivery network for teams managing complex mail at scale.

pricing_page.notes: The public page compares Developer, Small Business, Growth, and Enterprise plans and provides pricing details.

named_customers.notes: These names appear as Lob customer stories or case studies.

employee_band.notes: Lob’s LinkedIn company profile reports a size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies Lob’s headquarters as San Francisco, United States.

founded_year.notes: Lob’s own announcement identifies the company as founded in 2013.

eng_blog.notes: The Engineering index includes technical posts on its SQS consumer and API migration to Nomad; the posts discuss Lob’s platform and identify software/infrastructure engineers.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center index contains many product and developer articles, and Lob also provides API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists five positions, including an Enterprise Account Executive, business operations, corporate counsel, partner operations, and USPS programs; none is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Lob’s public API documentation, Help Center, engineering blog, Trust Center, and current subprocessors page were checked; none names an AI model provider used by Lob’s product.

compliance_certs.notes: Lob’s Trust Center lists SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR under Compliance; GDPR is a regulatory framework rather than a certification, but is included because the page names it.

last_funding.notes: Lob announced $50 million in Series C funding on February 25, 2021; CB Insights identifies this as its latest funding round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding was the February 2021 Series C, well before the 18-month window preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The active job board lists an Enterprise Account Executive position.

launched_6mo.notes: Lob announced its No-Code Design Suite on August 31, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On November 12, 2025, Lob announced appointments of a CFO, CPO, and CRO; the announcement falls within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Lob’s subprocessors page names Marketo and Mutiny for customer sales lead management, Salesforce.com for customer management/support, and Mailchimp as an email marketing provider.
